citation.quote: Heart rate 48. Hold metoprolol until the heart rate is reviewed on Thursday.

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Heart rate of 48 bpm indicates symptomatic or potentially unstable bradycardia; holding metoprolol is appropriate, but continuation despite this order poses risk of worsening bradycardia or hemodynamic compromise.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Confirm whether metoprolol was held per instruction on 2026-08-15 and verify current heart rate and rhythm; document resolution of the hold decision after Thursday review.
